channel.title: Adjona Business Applications Insights
channel.description: Practical answers about Dynamics 365 Sales, Business Central, Dataverse and choosing applications around an operational process.

item.title: What earns an opportunity a place in your January forecast?
item.description: A December pipeline review is more useful when every expected sale has a next step the buyer has actually agreed.

item.title: Did every website enquiry reach Dynamics 365?
item.description: A successful test submission proves one enquiry arrived. A better test also shows what staff will see if the next submission only gets halfway through.

item.title: When does a shared inbox need a work queue?
item.description: A shared mailbox can show who has written to you. When several people must act on the same request, the harder question is who owes the next reply.

item.title: When does your business need Dynamics 365 instead of Excel, SharePoint or Microsoft Lists?
item.description: Excel, Microsoft Lists, Power Apps, Business Central or Dynamics 365 Sales: how to tell when a more structured application is worth the cost and effort.

item.title: How Dynamics 365 Sales connects to Business Central through Dataverse
item.description: Understand the connection, record ownership and the checks that make a handover useful.

item.title: Power Apps or Dynamics 365 Sales: where should you start?
item.description: Compare an established sales application with a tailored application by looking at the process you need to manage.
